svg.title: T14.4_unified_decoder_subsystem_architecture
svg.text: T14.4 Unified LTE / NR Decoder Subsystem
Shared DMA, soft buffer, register control, three independent decoder engines, status, IRQ and trace.

text.tspan: family, task id, length, soft-buffer key, bitwidth
profile, start, timeout and trace mask.
Polar engine and locks immutable context.
Fetches LLR blocks or rate-recovered vectors
with valid masks and byte-lane tags.
Writes decoded payload, CB status, selected
SISO A/B, alpha/beta RAM, extrinsic RAM, interleaver
QC schedule ROM, layered controller, CN min1/min2, VN
SC/SCL tree, LLR and partial-sum state, PM sorter, path
Keyed by carrier / HARQ / TB epoch / CB / family; RV belongs to access
Schedules input, output, soft-buffer RMW and
engine-local burst access without crossing task
Stores checkpoint id, descriptor hash, first
mismatch fields, counters and optional waveform

path.data-note: trace->output DMA 诊断路径：沿引擎行上方走廊绕行，不穿 NR Polar Engine

text.tspan: BG, Zc, iLS, RV, CBG mask
N, K, E, list size, RNTI context
No active task; regs writable except sticky status.
Descriptor locked and family-specific legality checks run.
DMA / soft buffer provide LLR and masks.
Only selected engine owns local memories.
Output DMA, status and soft-buffer lifetime update.
3GPP specs define task context, not this register map. Each engine can run with private mock DMA and private trace.
Shared resources never own algorithm state. Soft-buffer writes are atomic per transaction. Trace uses T13.6 checkpoint names.
IRQ summarizes status; debug keeps evidence.
